title: 会爬树的恐龙
subtitle: 小小的，抓着树干往上蹭
character: wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt, dark blue shorts and grey sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible hatching strokes and soft layered shading, moss green, warm brown and pale gold

pages.zh:
院子里有一棵大树，
我怎么也爬不上去。
爸爸说很久以前，
有一种小恐龙，
天天住在树上。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy standing under a tall tree in a backyard, one hand resting on the trunk, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, a little frustrated.

pages.zh:
它的名字叫小盗龙。
从头到尾巴尖，
只有一只乌鸦那么长。
它站在地上的时候，
还没我的小腿高。

它的爪子又细又尖，
一钩就挂住树皮。
后腿使劲一蹬，
身子往上蹭一截，
再往上钩一下。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur gripping the side of a tall tree trunk with its front claws, its body held upright against the bark. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最奇怪的地方是，
它四条腿上
都长着长长的羽毛。
前面一边一片，
后面也是一边一片。

它大概不会扇翅膀，
只会一路往下滑。
从这棵树上跳出去，
在空中飘一段，
落到那棵树上。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur gliding through the air between two tall trees with its arms and legs spread wide and its feathers fanned out. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
爱爬树的那些鸟，
爪子弯得厉害；
在地上跑的鸟，
爪子就要直一些。
小盗龙的爪子很弯。

住在树上有什么好？
树上没有大家伙。
它睡在高高的枝上，
地面上谁走过去，
谁也够不着它。
pages.scene: One small feathered dinosaur asleep on a high branch while a much larger dinosaur walks past on the ground far below. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
从十米高的树上跳下去，
它能在空中飘出
二三十米远。
树要是再高一点，
它就能飘得更远。

它的化石压在石板里，
羽毛一根一根，
都留在石头上。
过了一亿两千万年，
还看得清清楚楚。
pages.scene: A flat grey slab of rock holding a small dinosaur skeleton pressed flat, with the shapes of long feathers preserved in the stone around its arms and legs. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有一块化石的肚子里，
还留着半条小鱼。
另外一块里，
有一只小鸟的脚。
它就吃这些东西。
pages.scene: A fossil of a small dinosaur pressed flat into grey stone, the small bones of a fish visible inside its ribcage, a flat illustration filling the whole picture, not a photograph of an open book. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
地上跑的恐龙
个个又大又凶。
它在地上谁也打不过，
就搬到高处去，
住在别人上不去的地方。

我又去看院子里的树。
树皮糙糙的。
要是我也有
那样一双尖爪子，
是不是就爬上去了？
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy pressing his hand flat against the rough bark of a tree trunk, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, thinking.
